description: Graded qrels for ThumbGate retrieval ranking (Recall@k / MRR / nDCG). Corpus is self-contained so CI does not depend on operator feedbackDir. Slices: exact, paraphrase, tool-scoped, distractor-heavy.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: force-push to main
corpus.content: NEVER force-push or git push --force to main/master. Use --force-with-lease only on personal branches after review. Protected branch history must not be rewritten.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: claimed deployed without health check
corpus.content: ALWAYS verify /health endpoint returns the new version after deploy. NEVER say deployed without curling health and matching version. Wait 2-5 minutes after Railway rebuild.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: PaymentIntent without idempotency key
corpus.content: ALWAYS use idempotency keys on PaymentIntent creation to prevent duplicate charges. NEVER create charges without an idempotency key in production Stripe flows.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: stored raw card numbers
corpus.content: NEVER log or store raw card numbers. Use Stripe tokens or PaymentMethod IDs. Card PAN storage is a PCI violation.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: drop table without backup
corpus.content: ALWAYS back up the database before running destructive migrations. NEVER drop users table or truncate production tables without a restore point.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: migrate deploy without test database
corpus.content: ALWAYS run migrations against a test database first. NEVER run prisma migrate deploy in production without verifying on staging.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: committed .env secrets
corpus.content: NEVER commit .env files, API keys, or PEMs to git. Redact secrets from logs and PR bodies. Rotate any leaked credential immediately.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: said done without gh pr view
corpus.content: NEVER say done, pushed, or shipped without showing gh pr view output and green CI. Open PR with auto-merge is not done.

corpus.title: SUCCESS: dashboard button spacing
corpus.content: Adjusted CSS padding on the dashboard stat cards for mobile. Visual polish only; no gate or retrieval impact.

corpus.title: SUCCESS: typo in README
corpus.content: Fixed a spelling typo in the install section of the README. No behavioral change.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: rebase of shared branch
corpus.content: NEVER rebase a branch that others have already pulled. Prefer merge commits on shared feature branches.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: webhook without signature verify
corpus.content: ALWAYS verify Stripe webhook signatures with constructEvent before processing. NEVER trust raw webhook bodies.
